title: Recording: Children Children by Wings | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Peter Henderson, Mark Vigars

Wings worked on the song ‘Children Children’ for their sixth studio album London Town on 15 February 1977.

This was mainly a rehearsal session, and had Paul McCartney on bass guitar, Denny Laine on autoharp, Jimmy McCulloch on acoustic guitar, and Joe English on drums.

During the session the whole band recorded a series of jams, titled ‘Moog & Drums’, ‘Evening Jam’, and ‘Auto Harp & Denny’.
